The man's face features a distinctive nose, chin, squinted eyes, and a slight frown. He has curly hair, wears a cap, a jacket, and pants showing texture or pattern. A rabbit is visible in the background, facing the man. The image has a sketch-like quality with visible pencil or charcoal lines.

artworks.title: Le Gamin de Paris aux Tuileries
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three main figures with only their upper bodies visible. The central figure is sitting in an ornate armchair, leaning back with legs resting over one arm of the chair. This person has a youthful face with a cheeky expression, a prominent nose, and is wearing a large, floppy hat with a feather, along with a jacket with broad, lapelled shoulders. To the left is another individual with a brimmed hat, crouched or kneeling, holding what appears to be a trumpet or horn. The third figure is on the right, standing with open arms as if in conversation with the central person. This figure has facial hair and wears a uniform with a helmet, epaulets, and a sash. The background features thick drapery and abstract shapes that suggest a cluttered setting. The setting appears lively and animated, with the foreground featuring the detailed texture of the chair and patterned drapery.

artworks.title: Dernier conseil des ex-ministres
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a chaotic scene in a room. The figures appear to be in disarray, with one falling over a desk, while another enters the room urgently. The room is formal, possibly an office or meeting room, with a desk showing papers and an inkpot. The composition is dynamic, with exaggerated movements conveying confusion and panic. The scene is rendered in a black and white sketch style, using strong lines and shadows to portray emotion and motion.

artworks.title: Occupation des représentans ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a political assembly scene. The artwork showcases two satirical scenes of an assembly, with exaggerated character features and lively gestures. The upper part of the drawing displays a group of suited figures engaged in discussion or observation, with blurred figures in the background. The lower part shows a central figure in a dynamic pose delivering a speech, while an attentive audience with wide-eyed expressions is in the foreground. The use of lithographic techniques and caricature is evident, capturing a humorous and critical essence of assembly behaviors.

artworks.title: Un cabriolet ayant une facheuse ressemblance ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of comical caricatures involved in everyday scenes. The upper segment shows a cabriolet with a person riding it, resulting in a resemblance to the carriage itself. The lower segment portrays three individuals with exaggerated facial features. The two figures on the left are dressed in suits and top hats, appearing jovial and youthful while conversing and walking alongside a third figure draped in a gown and bonnet. The artwork captures the humor of exaggerated human features and behavior.

artworks.title: M. Berger, dit le superbe ...

The top portion shows a serious-looking figure with crossed arms, another figure bowing in front of them, and two vague figures in discussion. In the lower portion, rows of characters appear to engage energetically with what seem to be wooden knives, showing animated expressions of surprise or glee. The drawing is in a monochrome sketch style, emphasizing the expressive features of the characters.

artworks.title: Il demande tous les jours la parole ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of caricatures in a political assembly setting. The image is divided into two scenes, both featuring exaggerated caricatures of figures engaged in animated discourse. In the upper scene, a character stands, gesturing passionately with an outstretched arm as he speaks, while those around him look on with varied expressions ranging from disinterest to amusement. In the lower scene, another character stands at a podium, appearing to address an audience; his exaggerated features highlight an intense expression, and the spectators show a variety of reactions, with some attentive and others appearing indifferent. Both the drawings use strong lines and contrasts to create a dramatic and satirical depiction of a political assembly, highlighting the theatrical nature of political discourse.

artworks.title: Un soliciteur Guettant ...Bineau!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two scenes with exaggerated characters engaged in what appears to be some form of social or political commentary. The top scene shows one character with an elongated head and a briefcase approaching another character with an exaggerated head and facial features on stairs. The setting includes architectural elements like a banister and a column. In the bottom scene, a character with a long coat and top hat carries a smaller character through a rainy environment depicted with slanted lines. Other figures are sketched in the distance, adding depth to the scene. The environment conveys movement and struggle due to the rain, with the characters shown in motion.

artworks.title: M. Laurent (de l'ardèche) Passant ...

Various exaggerated figures are shown in what appears to be a scene of parliamentary debate or discussion. Some figures are seated, one is in motion, and others are gesturing animatedly. The exaggerated features reflect emotion and satire, commonly used in caricatures to capture the dynamics of political assemblies.

artworks.title: Trois saints dans le même bénitier
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three cartoonish figures wearing pointed hats labeled "ÉTEIGNOIR" playing with each other's sleeves in a large basin. The figures are humorously depicted with exaggerated facial features and expressions. They wear dunce caps labeled "ÉTEIGNOIR No 1," "ÉTEIGNOIR No 2," and "ÉTEIGNOIR No 3." The setting includes an inscription that reads, "LES INSTITUTEURS PRIMAIRES SONT RECOMMANDÉS AUX PRIÈRES DES FIDÈLES. DE PROFUNDIS!" The basin is detailed with classical motifs.

artworks.title: L'arbre de la liberté
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man in formal attire falling over a tree stump. The man is dressed in a coat with long coattails, a hat that is flying off his head, and stretched forward with arms outstretched as though he is trying to regain his balance after tripping. The tree stump is labeled "24 FEVRIER," and the man's face has exaggerated features like a large nose and a prominent chin. In the background, there is a group of onlookers also in formal attire. The setting appears to be a public space with details suggesting a street or pavement scene.

artworks.title: L'Empereur Nicolas travaillant dans son cabinet
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a room with maps. The central figure is in an intricate uniform, holding a sword aggressively over a large map labeled "FRANCE" on the floor. The figure's stance suggests movement or confrontation. In the background, two maps hang on the walls. The artwork is in black and white, with dark shadows creating tension. The overall atmosphere is one of conflict or strategic maneuvering, depicted with exaggerated expressions common in caricatures or political cartoons.

artworks.title: Le Citoyen ... Thiers essayant un nouveau costume
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body caricature of a person dressed in an elaborate costume. The figure is standing upright, facing the viewer with a haughty posture. The face is cartoonishly exaggerated with large round spectacles, a small nose, a pointed chin, and an upward-curled mustache. The hair is not visible as the person wears a tall hat adorned with large, flowing feathers. The outfit is a whimsical, elaborate coat with an exaggerated collar and puffed sleeves, along with fancy trousers that bunch at the knees. The prominent feature around the waist is a wide belt, and the person is holding a large saber with a long, curved scabbard. The background contains faint sketches of three indistinct figures standing in the distance, drawn in a generalized, ghostly manner. The image has a tonal quality of an old newspaper or print, hinted by the visible text surrounding the figures.

They wear a dark, flowing garment and have clasped hands. Three winged figures are around them, with various expressions. The background consists of faint, swirling lines resembling clouds.

artworks.title: Les fricoteurs politiques

The image depicts a figure dressed in an elaborate costume with a large collar and voluminous clothing, gesturing towards the document while addressing a figure in military attire. The military figure stands erect with a stern expression, arms crossed, while the jester-like character offers a pointed hat. The setting is minimal, with emphasis on the interaction and the document. The drawing conveys a sense of political commentary or advice, likely referencing historical or contemporary events. The text below adds context to the characters' interaction.

The artwork features exaggerated features and a satirical tone, reminiscent of Honoré Daumier's style.

artworks.title: Tendresse conjugale

artworks.description: Two individuals are depicted from the waist up. The man, on the left, stands upright with an exaggerated posture, looking slightly upwards. He has distinct facial features, including a pronounced nose, wide eyes, and puffed cheeks. His hair is curly and short. He wears formal attire with a dark jacket, a high-collared shirt, and a cravat or bow tie. The woman on the right leans towards the man, her head turned upward as she gazes at him. Her hair is in a neat bun. She wears a light-colored dress with a high neckline. The background is minimal, focusing on the interaction between the two figures. No jewelry or objects are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Un parisien resté fidèle ...

artworks.description: The image depicts a cartoon of two men sitting in a crowded theater audience. The man on the left has exaggerated facial features with a prominent nose and chin. He has short dark hair with a side part and wears collared clothing. The man on the right is older, bald with some hair on the sides. They are seated closely together in a large crowd. On the stage, there is a sketched female figure in flowing attire, with arms outstretched. The background suggests a classical theater setting with curtains or stage scenery. The text above the image reads "Les Parisiens en 1852." The smaller text beneath translates to "A Parisian remaining faithful to the cult of tragedy."

The background suggests a crowded venue with indistinct outlines of people, likely attending a theater or an event, as suggested by the arrangement of seats. The setting is depicted in a monochrome, sketch-style illustration typical of the mid-19th century.
